title: ResponseCompactionBlock
description:
A compaction block returned when autocompact is triggered.

When content is None, it indicates the compaction failed to produce a valid
summary (e.g., malformed output from the model). Clients may round-trip
compaction blocks with null content; the server treats them as no-ops.

content.description: Summary of compacted content, or null if compaction failed
content.title: Content

encrypted_content.description: Opaque metadata from prior compaction, to be round-tripped verbatim
encrypted_content.title: Encrypted Content

signature.description: Signature over the summary, to be sent back with the block verbatim
signature.title: Signature

tool_changes.description: The tool changes of the compacted range: the `tool_addition` and `tool_removal` blocks that take the request's `tools` to the tool set in effect at the end of the range, or `[]` when the range changed no tool. Absent when the server did not compute them. Send the block back unchanged.
tool_changes.title: Tool Changes
